messages.subject: [D-RUG] Presentation + work group this week
parts:
Hey folks,

This week at D-RUG, I'll be doing a very informal "presentation" called "Tips and Tricks in R/RStudio". The idea is for everyone to share some of their favorite packages, functions, and even keyboard shortcuts that make life easier in R/RStudio. I've got a few of my favorites ready to go, and I'm hoping everyone else will share some as well!

The "presentation" will go for an hour at most, and we'll have our regular work session during the second hour.

Hope to see you there!

--
Michael Culshaw-Maurer
PhD Candidate in Ecology
Rosenheim/Schreiber Labs
Briggs 320/Storer 5350
